concerns.text: T013 relies on an '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM]' to use YOLOv8 for bounding box integrity checks (FR-001). The spec mandates excluding clips where the subject area is reduced >95%. Relying on an external, unverified model without a defined fallback or exclusion logic for when YOLOv8 fails constitutes a semantic weakening of FR-001's mandatory exclusion requirement.

T029 implements an independent samples test (Welch's t-test/Mann-Whitney U) for 'Original Unmodified vs. Distorted'. The spec (FR-005) and Success Criteria (SC-002) explicitly mandate a PAIRED statistical test (t-test/Wilcoxon) to compare the same source IDs under different distortions. This task introduces a methodological deviation that violates the core statistical requirement of the spec.

T013 generates 'square-cropped clips' as the control set. The Plan (Technical Context) and Constitution (Principle VI) explicitly define the control group as 'ORIGINAL unmodified source videos' to ensure no generation artifacts confound the comparison. Generating square-cropped clips as the primary control violates the 'Geometric Stress-Testing Integrity' principle and the Plan's methodology.

T013 describes generating a 'set' of clips and a 'representative subset' without committing to the specific count (500 total, 125 per ratio) mandated by FR-001. This ambiguity risks under-powering the statistical test required by SC-001/SC-002, effectively weakening the dataset completeness requirement.

T020 mentions a fallback to 'FP16 for Vision Encoder only' but lacks the explicit logging and deviation tracking required by FR-002 ('log the deviation'). Without a specific task to implement the logging mechanism for fallback events, the requirement to track deviations is not fully preserved in the implementation plan.
